mechanics.claim: Quickdraw resets Graves' basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Quickdraw {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Graves''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Quickdraw's current cooldown is reduced per pellet that hits an enemy, allowing faster recasts (and thus more reload/attack speed uptime).
mechanics.quote: ''Quickdraw's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds for every {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} impacting an enemy.

mechanics.claim: Dashing toward an enemy champion grants 2 stacks of True Grit instead of 1.
mechanics.quote: Dashing towards an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates 2 stacks of ''True Grit''.

mechanics.claim: Subsequent casts of Quickdraw and dealing damage to non-minions refresh the duration of True Grit stacks.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent casts of ''Quickdraw'' and damage versus non-{{tip|minions}} will refresh the duration of ''True Grit''.
